prompt: clean isometric cutaway illustration, technical drawing style, axonometric projection. rationale: A technical isometric cutaway perfectly captures the mathematical and structural nature of a multi-line order basket, visually explaining how one missing component invalidates the entire assembly.
cue: raised to the power of the lines
subject: a ten-compartment order routing tray with one missing module
core_thesis: Order fill is roughly line fill raised to the power of the lines on the order, meaning a single missing SKU fails the entire multi-line shipment despite high overall stock metrics.
core_conflict: Per-line stock metric optimism versus exponential complete-order failure math.
